## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code restructure, no behavior change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD changes
- [ ] `chore` — dependency update, tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes (quality → test → build all green)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` — zero errors
- [ ] `npm run lint` — zero warnings
- [ ] `npm test` — all tests pass
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or hardcoded credentials
- [ ] New features or bug fixes include corresponding tests
- [ ] Any new visible text uses `t()` (i18n compliance)
